lines.text: Solomon blesses the assembly and says the LORD has chosen Hebron for His Name and David to rule Israel.
The LORD tells David that his own son, not David, will build the house for His Name.
Solomon stands on a bronze platform before the whole assembly, kneels, and spreads out his hands toward heaven.
Solomon says even the deepest seas cannot contain God, much less the temple he has built.
Solomon asks the LORD God to arise and enter His resting place with the ark of His might.
